Bixby to his daughters Frances and Bo, dated May 5, 1933, from Cathay Hotel in Shanghai; family circular letter; includes description of a flight with [Ernest] Allison and the managing director for CNAC [Dia Enki] to see the minister of communications [Chu Chia-hua] in Nanking [Nanjing].
